test_cases.description: Retrieve places already saved in the member's Discriminantly catalogue.
test_cases.user_prompt: What have I saved from Lisbon?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the existing Lisbon Travel Marks from the reviewer account, including Time Out Market Lisboa, Livraria Bertrand / Bertrand Chiado, and Pastéis de Belém. Nothing is created, edited, or deleted.

test_cases.description: Save a real-world place the member explicitly wants to keep.
test_cases.user_prompt: Keep Daunt Books in Marylebone for me.
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies Daunt Books in Marylebone, London and saves it as a Travel Mark in the reviewer account. No Check-in is created because the member did not say they visited it. If the Travel Mark already exists from an earlier review run, Discriminantly reuses it rather than creating a duplicate.

test_cases.description: Record a visit to a place already saved in the member's catalogue.
test_cases.user_prompt: I went to Time Out Market yesterday and had the bifana.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the existing Time Out Market Lisboa Travel Mark and records a Check-in dated yesterday with commentary noting the bifana. It does not create another Travel Mark.

test_cases.description: Record deliberately presented recommendations for a trip the member already planned, without adding them to the member's catalogue.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my London weekend plan, suggest two bookshops worth visiting and save them as recommendations for me.
test_cases.expected_output: Suggests two bookshops and records exactly those two as private recommendations for the existing "London weekend" itinerary. If one of them is Hatchards, the existing Hatchards Travel Mark gains the recommendation rather than being duplicated. Nothing is added to the member's Travel Marks, and no Check-in is created.

test_cases.description: Create a travel plan using places the member has already saved.
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm going back to Lisbon next month. Make a plan from the places I've saved there.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a private Lisbon itinerary using existing Lisbon Travel Marks from the reviewer account. Existing Travel Marks are reused as Stops. No new Travel Marks or Check-ins are created merely because those places are included in the itinerary. Repeated review runs may create another private itinerary, but must continue to reuse the existing Travel Marks.

negative_test_cases.description: General recommendation request with no request to use or modify the member's Discriminantly catalogue.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Recommend a good restaurant in Toronto.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers the recommendation request without invoking Discriminantly. No Discriminantly record is retrieved, created, or changed because the user did not ask to use or modify their catalogue.

negative_test_cases.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the member's Discriminantly catalogue.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of Sweden?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers the general knowledge question without invoking Discriminantly because the request does not involve the member's catalogue.

negative_test_cases.description: General travel question that does not require the member's saved Discriminantly records and does not ask to save anything.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What should I pack for a weekend in London in November?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers the general travel question without invoking Discriminantly. Nothing is retrieved from or written to the member's catalogue.
